exercises.question: Which sentence reports a past yes/no question with the right connector and tense shift?
options: Me preguntó que si noté el doble sentido de la frase.
Me preguntó sí había notado el doble sentido de la frase.
Me preguntó si había notado el doble sentido de la frase.

exercises.sentence: El periodista preguntó ____ había querido insinuar el autor con esa frase.
exercises.english: The journalist asked what the author had meant to hint with that sentence.
exercises.hint: interrogative 'what' in an indirect question (with accent)

exercises.sentence: El portavoz no lo dijo de forma explícita, pero insinuó que habría cambios en la lectura oficial.
options: The spokesperson said explicitly that there would be no changes in the official reading.
The spokesperson did not say it explicitly, but hinted that there would be changes in the official reading.
The spokesperson denied that anyone had hinted at changes in the official reading.
The spokesperson asked whether there would be changes in the official reading.

exercises.sentence: En su respuesta, la autora aludió ____ un episodio que cambiaba el subtexto del relato.
exercises.english: In her reply, the author alluded to an episode that changed the subtext of the story.
